messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — we're set to tag v3.4.0 in ~30m. Need someone to create an annotated (GPG) tag and push. After that Samir will upload artifacts + checksums and create the GH draft release. Plan: push tag -> upload artifacts -> open draft (pre-release) -> QA smoke -> publish. Any objections?
Aisha: I can do the annotated tag. Which commit should I tag?
Jordan: Tag the tip of release/3.4 (commit: a1b2c3d). package.json bump already merged to that branch.
Samir: I'll prep artifact upload and checksum files. Ping me once tag is pushed.
Claire: Quick changelog note: PR #789 has a tiny wording tweak — should we include it in the release notes?
Jordan: yes, include that line under "Bug fixes". Keep it brief.
release-bot: Reminder: ensure GPG key is available on CI for signing or sign locally and push signed tag.
Aisha: I'll sign locally. Tag command I'll run: `git tag -s -a v3.4.0 -m "v3.4.0" a1b2c3d && git push origin v3.4.0`
Samir: For artifacts use: `sha256sum mybinary > mybinary.sha256` and upload both the binary and the .sha256. I will upload to s3://redwood-releases/3.4.0/ and then paste links in the draft.
Claire: I can run a quick CVE scan on the built artifacts after upload. Will report back.
Aisha: Tag pushed and signed. Tag info: `v3.4.0 -> tagger: Aisha (signed), message: v3.4.0`, commit a1b2c3d.
Samir: Received ping — starting artifact upload now. s3 paths: `s3://redwood-releases/3.4.0/redwood-linux-amd64.tar.gz` and `.../redwood-darwin-amd64.tar.gz`. Checksums uploaded to same location as `.sha256` files.
Samir: Draft release created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/draft/12345 — added binaries + checksum files, marked pre-release. Please review release notes (I copied changelog + PR #789 tweak).
Claire: CVE scan results: no critical findings, two low-severity deps flagged but are transitive and tracked.
Jordan: timeline: tag now (done), QA smoke in ~2h, publish at 14:15 UTC after signoff. If anything blocks, reply here.
Aisha: For record, git show summary: ```commit a1b2c3d
Author: Jordan <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: ...

    release: bump to v3.4.0
```
Samir: I've also attached a checksums file `3.4.0.sha256` with entries:
```
9f2c1b5b6e8c1a3d4f5e6a7b8c9d0e1f  redwood-linux-amd64.tar.gz
7e1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c  redwood-darwin-amd64.tar.gz
```
Jordan: LGTM. Once QA confirms, publish and I'll close the milestone.
release-bot: Note: created release-tracker task #456 for v3.4.0 publish checklist.
Claire: :thumbsup:
Samir: Will wait for QA signoff then hit publish button on the draft.
Jordan: Thanks everyone — I'll post final publish confirmation here when done.
